title: Ethiopian Soya Bean Misir Wot
description: A hearty and flavorful dish made with soya beans, onions, garlic, and spices. This recipe is a variation of the traditional Ethiopian Misir Wot.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add 1 cup of soya beans and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add 2 tablespoons of berbere spice and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the soya beans are tender.
Stir in 1 tablespoon of niter kibbeh (Ethiopian clarified butter).
Serve the Misir Wot hot over injera bread or with rice.
